contrasts.meaning: exercise modification of the Dsp-genotype effect (paper's rescue / interaction, S6.4.p11)

contrasts.name: geno_DH_vs_WT_age-M6_act-EX
contrasts.meaning: residual dysregulation in exercised mice (rescue, S6.4.p6)

contrasts.name: geno_DH_vs_WT_age-M3_act-RA
contrasts.meaning: baseline genotype effect at 3M (S6.1.p4), not an exercise contrast

decisions.reason: The paper's within-genotype exercise contrasts (S6.4.p4-p5) cannot be separated from a processing batch that coincides exactly with the exercise arm. Each batch, however, holds 5 WT and 5 DH mice, so the genotype effect within a batch and the genotype x exercise interaction (difference of within-batch genotype effects) cancel an additive batch shift. The interaction is the paper's own test of exercise rescue (S6.4.p11) and is the identifiable exercise estimand; it is primary. The within-batch genotype contrasts are secondary (6M) and exploratory (3M). One model on all 30 samples with a cell factor.

covariates.name: batch
covariates.disposition: aliased: identical to age x act; absorbed by the cell factor, cancels in within-batch genotype contrasts and in the genotype x exercise interaction; it is why the simple EX vs RA contrasts were rejected at design

covariates.name: sex
covariates.disposition: excluded: not in GEO metadata and not modelled by the paper; inferred from Xist/Ddx3y counts it is balanced across genotypes within every batch (3M 3F/2M each genotype, 6M-RA 2F/3M each, 6M-EX 1F/4M each)

decisions.reason: Independent animals, no repeated measures. Batch inference: the deposited matrix is a combination of three count tables (ERCC rows: absent in 6M-EX, all-zero 3-row set in 3M, a different subset in 6M-RA); technical read fractions (misc_RNA, Mt_tRNA nonzero only in 3M) form three non-overlapping groups matching 3M, 6M-RA and 6M-EX. Paper says alignment by Tophat2, GEO says HISAT2, also consistent with mixed processing.

selected.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2, joint cell model) for the interaction and all within-batch contrasts; edgeR QL (inmoose, two-arm) for the paper-method genotype contrasts

paper_route.method: edgeR GLM with genotype x exercise interaction
paper_route.reason: the runner's edgeR executor (tools/edger_tools.py) fits only two-arm ~ Treatment; no interaction contrast. The interaction runs on the validated joint DESeq2 count model instead.

deviations: interaction and joint contrasts by DESeq2 Wald instead of edgeR
edgeR executor has no filterByExpr step, so its BH universe is all non-zero genes (~30k) instead of the paper's ~11k analysed genes

decisions.reason: Raw counts support DESeq2/edgeR. edgeR reproduces the paper's method for the two-arm genotype contrasts; the interaction needs a multi-cell count model, which only the joint DESeq2 executor offers.

selected.deviation_note: paper's q<0.05 (edgeR BH FDR) applied unchanged to DESeq2 padj for the primary interaction and joint contrasts, and to edgeR padj for the two-arm runs

decisions.reason: S5.7.p2: significance level q<0.05, no fold-change cutoff.
One DESeq2 model on all 30 samples with the age x geno x act cell factor; the interaction (primary) and within-batch genotype contrasts are extracted from it.
Paper-method (edgeR) DH vs WT at 6M regular activity (paper 781).
Paper-method (edgeR) DH vs WT among exercised mice: residual dysregulation after exercise (rescue question) within one batch.
Paper-method (edgeR) DH vs WT at 3M (paper 56); context only, not an exercise contrast.
Interaction and exercised-mouse genotype contrast without 6M-EX-DH4, the mouse that stopped exercising at 2.5 months with heart failure (S6.4.p3, S6.4.p6); DH-EX n=4.

caveats: The paper's within-genotype exercise contrasts (WT EX vs RA 2529, DH EX vs RA 2391) were not run: exercise is aliased with a processing batch in the deposited data.
The exercise answer is the genotype x exercise interaction (rescue) and the residual DH vs WT difference among exercised mice, both within batch.
Interaction on DESeq2 instead of edgeR; edgeR runs test all non-zero genes.
One DH-EX mouse (6M-EX-DH4, heart failure: Nppa/Myh7 ~10x) included as in the paper; sensitivity run without it.

decisions.reason: Paper counts from S6.4.p11 (65 interaction), S6.1.p5 (781), S6.1.p4 (56). Genes: secreted WNT inhibitors rescued by exercise (S7.p3), regulators not rescued (S6.4.p7), top 3M genes (S6.1.p4).
